children: Taiwan’s retail sales increased 6.5% year-on-year in August 2026, easing from an upwardly revised 7.8% rise in July.

Growth slowed in fuel and related products (6.5% vs 12.9% in July), motor vehicles, motorcycles and related parts and accessories (5.8% vs 12.6%), pharmaceutical and medical goods and cosmetics (4.5% vs 7.5%), general merchandise stores (6.4% vs 7.1%), information and communications equipment (10.9% vs 13.3%), cultural and recreation goods (1.6% vs 4.4%) and textiles and clothing (1.6% vs 3.8%).

Meanwhile, sales strengthened in food, beverages and tobacco (13.1% vs 6.5%), construction materials (12.7% vs 8.0%), electronic shopping and mail-order houses (8.5% vs 5.5%), household appliances and goods (5.5% vs 6.0%) and retail trade not in stores or stalls (5.3% vs 1.8%).
On a monthly basis, retail sales fell 0.5%, following a 0.6% decline in July.

title: Taiwan Retail Sales Growth Eases in August
